tracking.note: negative letter-spacing scales up with font size (optical tightening)

notes: Two-value brand system: acid green field + black ink; muted = ink @60%. Card surfaces (#242424 / #FFFFFF / #E44CE7) are per-product, not global roles. Type scale normalized px->rem from 14/16/20/24/60/72/208; 60px dropped from headline scale as a near-duplicate of 72 and 208 (the fluid display max). Hierarchy is scale-driven at a near-constant 400 weight. No shadows/gradients (flat). Page is static apart from a footer <canvas> ASCII halftone field + custom cursor follower (both spectacle-only, ~725 rAF / 40 mousemove observed); the only resting transition token is the 200ms hover ease. prefers-reduced-motion has no rules.
